conclusions: Nine later-step cases pass with actual production kernel fd release/last-fd/dup on two simulated USB devices. Early prefix, selected terminal frame, exact parameters, every original Complete digest/length, original deadline, Cancelled outcome, independent ownership and three captured peer MAC probes corroborate.

Scan START cancellation requires a new actual STOP after its late original reply. The old successful START never confirms On or succeeds the old request. Scan final STOP cancellation retains its original successful Off proof with no duplicate STOP. Advertising final STOP preserves earlier actual selected power and confirms advertising Off before separate scan cleanup.

All six later scan cases pass even with model idle STOP refusal enabled; the START case stops a truly active model scanner and final STOP case sends no duplicate idle STOP. This does not establish physical firmware111 behavior.

Three later advertising idle-scan-STOP refusals retain original VM FAIL, Cancelled/-ECANCELED, EIO/status0b, RecoveryBlocked/Faulted and Unknown radio state. Independent corroboration does not normalize these failures into Ready/Free or success.

The peer remains independent Setup with Diagnostic ownership and actual kernel/model USB query success. Active Ready peer activity, RF, real host-libusb hold, scheduler concurrency and all current real Managed gates remain unqualified.
Twelve historical first-step format3 cases reverify using the new verifier. Historical real WS73 evidence, prior failed bootstrap evidence and all original issue scope remain unchanged.

Four real devices remain enumerated with effective host permissions; ports1-3 are five-endpoint runtime, port4 two-endpoint ROM. Readonly power status is active; no new physical USB transfer, reset, hub cycle, host module/kernel/service or PM/permission change was executed.

Previously authorized ganged hub off/on trials did not restore Ready or establish cold SoC power. Such hub-wide cycling cannot qualify independent device recovery. Natural root cause and automatic recovery remain OPEN.
